visualCharacteristics.purpose: Expandable FAQ / detail items with chevron toggle
visualCharacteristics.layout: Bordered stacked items; chevron rotates when open

contentPattern.structure: cell 1 item title (H3); cell 2 panel content (an empty panel adopts the next block in the section, e.g. a product-table)

usage: FAQs and tariff details on program pages
reuseGuidance: Reuse accordion for new pages with the same content pattern; add an option class rather than a new block for colour or layout differences.
